big_case.notes: The petition presents a nationally consequential boundary between federal research-funding discretion and protection against viewpoint discrimination, affecting academic speech and competitive grants across agencies. The interlocutory vehicle and denial leave that constitutional boundary unresolved; this order itself establishes no nationwide merits rule.
